title: Sum of Absolute Differences in a Sorted Array
description: Given a non-decreasing integer array `nums`, return an array `answer` where `answer[i]` is the sum of `abs(nums[i] - nums[j])` over every index `j`. Input: sorted `nums`. Output: the corresponding sum array.
constraints: nums is sorted in non-decreasing order
hints: Scan once to identify the boundary or state where the answer changes.
Test already ordered, reversed, duplicate, and minimum-size inputs.
